body: The dish cloth and road map are tied with cut warning tape. Six tally cuts mark the dish cloth, but only four are crossed through.
title: Dish cloth and map

body:
Leave the canisters outside the fence until the grounds crew finishes the spray test. The gate was already locked when the delivery arrived; the return form charges us for the missing seal.

The grass along the fence went brown in stripes by the next day. Every canister carried a trial label, and the crew had no one left to ask.
title: Notepad page
